Elena,

Thanks again for booking the Concordia Immersion for Nov 18. Attached is our working agenda (redwood-initial-agenda-v1.pdf) — please consider it a draft and flag any must-have sessions. A few quick items we need to lock from your side so we can finalize travel and on-site staffing: 

- Preferred arrival window for the Redwood team (we're proposing two engineers + one CS lead): 08:30–09:15 or 10:00–10:45. Which works for your security desk?
- Confirm a single point of contact at your building for badge collection and an on-site escort for the day.
- Any AV constraints (no internet, projector constraints, or laptop-only breakout rooms)?
- Dietary restrictions for the working lunch.
- Do you provide parking passes for vendors or should we request visitor permits?

If you can confirm those by EOD Tuesday (11/10), we'll submit travel holds and parking requests. We'll also share an escort roster once travel is booked.

Thanks — looking forward to a productive day.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom — thanks for the agenda. Friday the 18th works. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Can the Redwood team aim for the earlier window (08:30–09:15)? That helps us with room set and an earlier tech walkthrough before lunch.
- We will provide an on-site escort (Tomas Rivera) and badge pickup at Lobby A (bring government ID).
- AV: Main room has HDMI + dual display; no wired internet at the podium (we can provide a hotspot if needed).
- Lunch will be boxed sandwiches; please send any dietary restrictions to venue-ops@concordiatech.com by 11/12.
- Parking: We can reserve two visitor permits (please share license plate numbers or we can print physical passes if you arrive together).

Also — could Redwood confirm which engineers will lead the demo sessions and whether they need any special kit (dongles, proprietary appliances)?

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Partnerships | Concordia Tech
elena@concordiatech.com
